newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN BEAT ABERDEEN IN PENALTY SHOOT-OUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HIBERNIAN BEAT ABERDEEN IN PENALTY SHOOT-OUT.

text.p: Former Aberdeen goalkeeper Jim Leighton was instrumental in sending his old side tumbling out of the Scottish Cup on Tuesday.

Leighton made a spectacular save to push aside Joe Miller's spot-kick as Hibernian won a a penalty shoot-out 5-3 after the two sides had failed to score in normal time and then extra time in their third round replay.
Miller's penalty was the second of Aberdeen's five.
Leighton, in inspired form, also saved a penalty by Duncan Shearer but the referee ordered it to be retaken and Shearer made no mistake second time around.
Pat McGinlay, Shaun Dennis, Iain Cameron, Brian Grant and Kevin Harper were Hibernian's successful marksmen from the spot.
The Edinburgh club's reward for their accuracy from the penalty spot was a plum fourth round home tie against championship contenders Celtic.
